concepts.proposed_markdown: Adyen's dated payout-currency guide distinguishes payment acquiring, settlement into an Adyen bank account, and a later payout to the merchant bank. Settlement currency depends on acquiring region and payment method; local versus SWIFT payout depends on the receiving-bank currency/location and the acquiring-connection table. Per-currency payout accounts are configured at merchant-account level. The page's blanket no-SWIFT statement for MXN and AED conflicts with EU/UK table rows marking cross-border payout available, so the applicable route requires current Adyen/account verification. [[source-adyen-docs-account-supported-currencies]]
warnings: Raw line 40 says no SWIFT for MXN/AED; EU and UK acquiring-connection tables mark cross-border payout for those currencies at lines 123, 138, 154 and 166.
